purpose: Teach: 英単語/地中海/フック/麓/猟/カウントダウン/詩集/強風

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、私、英単語、必死に、勉強してたよな、ばあさん、覚えてる?当時は、辞書、いつも、持ち歩いていたぞ、本気で、頑張ってた時代だった、本当に、絶対、本当に、本気で、本当に。
lines.en: When I was young, I used to study English words so hard, Gran—do you remember? I always carried a dictionary with me in those days. It was a time when I was truly giving it everything.
lines.style: Soft nostalgic tone, deliberate pacing. Touches each memory like holding something fragile. Voice grows quieter on the questions, as if speaking more to himself than asking. Gentle warmth underneath the reminiscing.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん。新婚旅行、地中海、本当に、行きたかったわよね、覚えてる?結局、行けなかったけれども、夢、あったわよね、本気で、絶対、本当に、忘れない、思い出よね、二人で。
lines.en: Yes. We really wanted to go to the Mediterranean for our honeymoon—do you remember? We never did make it in the end, but we had that dream, didn't we? Those memories, the two of us... I haven't forgotten them.
lines.style: Wistful, slightly tremorous opening. Breath held on the longing. Picks up gentle certainty when speaking of the memory itself. Settles into warmth at 'the two of us.' No rush—lingering on each image.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 昔の釣具屋、フック、種類、本当に、豊富だったよな、ばあさん、覚えてる?お祖父ちゃん、本当に、釣り、好きだったよな、家族で、楽しい時間、過ごしたよな、本気で、絶対、本当に。
lines.en: The old fishing tackle shop had such a wide variety of hooks, Gran—do you remember? Grandfather loved fishing so much. We spent such good times together as a family. Really, truly good times.
lines.style: Quieter, more inward. Gentle smile in the voice. Slight pause before each detail, like opening a drawer of old photographs. Slows on family moments. Trails off softly at the end, content to sit with the memory.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃、二人で、富士山の麓、よく、訪れたわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本当に、思い出に、残ってるわよね、本気で、絶対、また、行きたいわね、いつか、二人で、絶対、約束しようね。
lines.en: When we were young, we used to visit the foothills of Mount Fuji often, don't you remember, dear? Those memories have stayed with me. I'd like to go again someday, just the two of us. Let's promise each other we will.
lines.style: Warm, reaching out gently. Open, vulnerable quality. The request builds with quiet hope—not demanding, but tender and sincere. Closes with a soft pledge, holding his hand in the voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 昔、地方で、狩猟、本当に、盛んだったんだよな、ばあさん、覚えてる?お祖父ちゃんの世代、本当に、自然と、共生していたよな、本気で、絶対、深い、思い出だな、本当に、本気。
lines.en: Hunting used to be very common in the countryside, Gran—do you remember? Grandfather's generation, they lived in true harmony with nature. Those are deep memories for me, really profound ones.
lines.style: Contemplative, almost philosophical. Slower, deeper breath. Gentle respect in the voice when speaking of the elder generation. Weight of time and understanding settles into the phrasing. No hurry—just quiet reflection.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 大晦日のカウントダウン、家族で、本当に、楽しんだわよね、覚えてる、あなた?孫が、生まれてから、特に、賑やかになったわよね、本気で、絶対、嬉しいわよね、いつも、家族の絆。
lines.en: We had such wonderful New Year's Eve countdowns together as a family, didn't we? Remember, dear? It became especially lively after the grandchildren were born. Those moments of togetherness, the family bond—they brought me such joy.
lines.style: Bright, warm current running through gentle speech. Liveliness in the voice when mentioning the grandchildren. Settles into deep contentment at the end. A smile that reaches the eyes, even in her voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、私、君に、詩集、何度か、プレゼントしたよな、ばあさん、覚えてる?ロマンチックだったよな、私、本当に、自分で、感心するくらい、本気で、絶対、二人の思い出だ。
lines.en: When I was young, I gave you collections of poetry more than once, Gran—do you remember? I was quite the romantic back then. I'm even a bit amazed at myself now. Those are memories that belong to the two of us.
lines.style: Tender embarrassment underneath. Soft chuckle quality in the voice—not quite laughing, but remembering with affection and a touch of self-consciousness. Gentle, intimate tone. Settles into quiet certainty at 'the two of us.'

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 最近、台風シーズン、強風が、続く時、本当に、心配ね、あなた、お互いに、家、しっかり、戸締まり、しましょうね、本気で、絶対、安全、第一にしましょう、本当に、約束ね、絶対。
lines.en: Lately, during typhoon season when the strong winds keep coming, I do worry about you. Let's both make sure to lock up our houses properly, all right? Safety has to come first for both of us. That's a promise, dear—a real one.
lines.style: Practical concern wrapped in affection. Clear and steady on the safety instructions—not fussy, but firm with care. Softens on the promise, holding it like something precious. The voice of someone who has learned to show love through watching over each other.
